files.title: Twelve puzzle sheets
files.description: Twelve of the book’s puzzles, one to a Letter page in Dudeney’s own words with the original figure and room to work. No answers on the sheet.

files.title: Hints booklet
files.description: One hint for every one of the 110 puzzles, numbered as in the book. A hint says where to look and never gives the answer.
